summary: The sketch toolbar draws with Select, Line, Arc, Polyline, Rectangle, Circle and Slot, with the L, A, P, R, C and O shortcuts. Line makes one line from two clicks and stays active. Arc takes the start, the end and a point on the arc, and adds its own center point. Polyline replaces the separate Polygon and Path tools and keeps the path tool id: it draws line and three-point arc segments, closes when a click returns to its start, finishes open with Enter or Finish polyline, and keeps Close with line. Polyline picks on existing geometry now create their own points and attach them with removable coincident relations when Create relations is on, instead of reusing the existing point identity. Slot takes both arc centers and then a width click at twice its distance from the center line, and draws two lines, two arcs and their centers, held by four tangent joints and one equal radius. Sketches that store profiles instead of graph geometry still save a slot profile centered between both arc centers, and a line-only polyline there still saves as a polygon profile. The segment mode button keeps its visible text Line and is now named Line segment, so it is not confused with the Line tool.
warning: No breaking change for installed posts, machine packages, saved revisions, CAD files or controller output. Saved slots, polygons and paths open and build as before and are not migrated. New slots in graph sketches are saved as lines and arcs with tangent and equal-radius relations instead of one slot profile, so they offer point and edge editing instead of the slot length, width and angle grips. A polyline that snaps to existing points now adds new points and coincident relations, which Create relations controls and which can be removed like other relations.

checklist.schema: No UPID, post, machine package, execution plan, saved revision, CAD schema, storage, journal or worker reply change. New geometry uses the existing sketch graph points, lines, arcs and tangent-joint, equal-radius and coincident relations. Post engine API remains 1 and saved-job engine remains 3.
checklist.events: No execution event, cancellation or input-version behavior change. WebMCP tools keep their arguments and result fields; agents author the same graph geometry with append-sketch-entities.
checklist.capabilities: No post or machine capability change. The CAD sketch toolbar adds Line and Arc, merges Polygon and Path into Polyline and changes how Slot is drawn.
checklist.auditAndOutput: No generation, audit, numbering, encoding, line ending, feed or controller-file change.
checklist.installationAndStorage: No installed package, revision, browser-cache or folder storage change. Existing slot, polygon and path profiles are read and saved unchanged.
checklist.verification: cadFreshSketchDrawing.test.ts checks the line, arc, polyline and slot graphs, their relations, picks and rejected degenerate input. cadPathDrawing.test.ts, cadPathDraftGraph.test.ts, CadSketchPathDrawing.test.tsx and CadSketchCanvasPicking.test.tsx check polyline drafts, closing on the start, open finishing, attachments and the profile fallback. CadWorkbench.test.tsx checks the toolbar order and shortcuts, two separate lines, an arc with its own center, a slot's lines, arcs, relations and area, and polyline closing and open finishing. e2e/cad-sketch-constraints.spec.ts and e2e/cad-workflow.spec.ts draw with Polyline in Chromium, including trim and delete repairs that attach new edges with coincident relations. The full Vitest suite, lint, ui:check, build and the release check.

publicNotes.summary: New Line and Arc tools, one Polyline tool and a three-click Slot.
changes: Line draws one line from two clicks and Arc draws a three-point arc with its own center; both stay active for the next shape.
Polyline replaces Polygon and Path. Click the start to close it, or press Enter or choose Finish polyline to keep it open.
Slot takes both arc centers and then the width, and draws lines and arcs that you can dimension and move.
Polyline points that snap to existing geometry attach with removable relations when Create relations is on.
publicNotes.compatibility: Installed machine packages, posts, saved revisions, CAD files and controller output are unchanged. Slots, polygons and paths saved earlier are not changed.
